notablePrerequisites: Tamiyo's Compleation attached to Ugin's Nexus.
description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
The token copy of Ugin's Nexus is put into exile as a state based action due to the legend rule, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
